raw_text:
Independent review of r-20261005T125229955482-ped-timeout-corpus at head db026f9d against base adb67e5f (plan imas-ambix:project-environment-declared §5). The node resolves the 12 rows for tests/fluxstate/, tests/data/test_machine_map.py, tests/challenge/test_loader.py, tests/test_filaments3d.py and tests/test_agent.py in the relock abort table. Read the reviewed worktree's five commits, its manifest, the per-file measurement logs and the four default-bound confirmation logs. The worktree was clean at db026f9d; this review changed nothing in it. The change is 86 insertions across exactly the five declared paths, no product source touched.

Verified independently: every measured duration in the fragment reconciles with the reviewed run's own logs -- machine_map 378.50 s (perfile-machine_map, load1 39.38) and 195.68 s (verify-machine_map-default), 13.37 s and 0.12 s (perfile-machine_map); challenge 753.26 s and 724.46 s (perfile-challenge-test_loader, load1 9.59); test_agent 900.28 s (perfile-test_agent, load1 40.87); filaments 270.59 s (perfile-filaments3d, load1 40.87); fluxstate setup 2693.92 s (confirm-fluxstate-consumer line 605). Mark arithmetic is correct in every case: 2*378.50->780, 2*753.26->1560, 2*724.46->1500, 2*2693.92->5400, each rounded up to a whole minute, and each comment states the measured seconds and the date. The test_agent wait is genuinely fixed through the existing CLIVE_CATALOG_RETRY_BOUND/CLIVE_CATALOG_RETRY_START knobs read in imas_ambix/agent/clive.py:216-220; the isolated run drops to 6.32 s and the file run to 22.70 s from the 900.28 s baseline. The negative control fires: with the 780 mark removed the machine_map inventory test aborts, negative-control-machine_map-no-mark.log ends '1 failed in 307.93s' and 'Failed: Timeout (>300.0s) from pytest-timeout.' with EXIT=1 -- the same test the marked head arm runs to completion.

Gaps. (1) The confirmation limb of the node's done-when is unmet for tests/fluxstate/test_consumer_contract.py: the default-bound confirm run ended '1 passed, 5 errors' EXIT=1 because the 2640 s mark was smaller than the 2693.92 s fixture setup, the mark was then raised to 5400 s and committed (cc558db9), but the default-bound re-run was never made -- the fragment's own confirmation table records it 're-run outstanding'. The five erroring tests are not recorded as 'left failing', so this file does not meet the node's own done-when, honestly reported under evidence_inputs/follow_ons. (2) The fragment gives load '8' for the 195.68 s machine_map measurement, but no log on disk carries that figure -- verify-machine_map-default.log, the only log holding 195.68, records load1 25.38. (3) The manifest's commits field lists four SHAs and omits the worktree head db026f9d, committed 9 s after the manifest was written (16:35:52 vs 16:36:01). (4) The machine_map mark is justified on its loaded measurement (378.50 s) while its light-load measurement (195.68 s) is under the 300 s default; the fragment states the borderline and the decision, but the mark is not strictly required by the plan's 'measure alone' rule.
